gate: G5 — The world is alive (bible v2 §21)
status: PRE-REGISTERED — committed before any results run. Results that follow a protocol change require a new registration entry; the old entry is never edited.
claim: The living core's opinion trajectory validates against historical opinion time-series; a real injected event yields a simulated reaction matching the measured one; demography matches UN-derived census projections.
on_failure: Fix the physics or narrow the domain — never let the LLM decide (bible v2 §7 risk table).

temporal.protocol: Calibrate per-question force weights on WVS Wave 6 country targets only (Wave 7 never touched during calibration — held out in time). Snapshot t0 force means. Evolve the living world through the W6->W7 interval (default 7 years, 30-day steps) with all endogenous mechanisms on (feedback, coupling, thresholds, rewiring, generational replacement) and zero hand-authored cohort drift; receiver off (no historical signal replay in v1). Re-predict per country at t1 with the SAME weights, feature-centered on the t0 means anchor so global secular drift is not silently subtracted. Score predicted deltas against observed W7-W6 deltas.
temporal.dataset: earth1/wvs_paired.py — 15 questions, WVS Wave 6 (2010-2014) vs Wave 7 (2017-2022), compiled from published aggregates.

metrics.mae_engine: mean |predicted_delta - observed_delta| over all (question, country) pairs
metrics.sign_accuracy: fraction of pairs with |observed_delta| >= 0.02 where sign(predicted) == sign(observed)
metrics.sign_p: one-sided binomial p-value of sign_accuracy against 0.5

temporal.pass: mae_engine < mae_nochange AND sign_accuracy > 0.5 with sign_p < 0.05
caveats: The genesis manifold is calibrated on ~2020-era sources, closer to Wave 7 than Wave 6; this tests whether endogenous dynamics move deltas in the observed direction, not full historical reconstruction.
WVS paired values are compiled from published aggregates and marked verify-against-official-database in the source file.

event_reaction.protocol: Encode a documented real event with its measured before/after poll values. Calibrate the case question's weights on the PRE-event country values only. Inject the event as force-delta WorldEvents scoped to the affected countries, tick the world through the measured reaction window, and compare the simulated shift to the measured shift.
event_reaction.case: COVID-19 onset rally-round-the-flag: trust in national government, Eurobarometer Standard EB 92 (autumn 2019) vs EB 93 (summer 2020), EU country toplines. Measured EU-average shift approximately +6pp. Injected as a FEAR + COLLECTIVE force shock scoped to the encoded EU countries, 90-day window, decay half-life 45 days.

metrics.sign_match: sign(simulated mean shift) == sign(measured mean shift)
metrics.magnitude_ratio: simulated mean shift / measured mean shift

caveats: EB country values compiled from published toplines; verify against GESIS archive.

Shock force-deltas are authored (magnitude chosen a priori at 0.15 fear / 0.10 collective, gain not tuned to the answer); the test is whether the ENGINE's propagation of an authored shock matches measured reality in sign and order of magnitude.

demography.protocol: Run the generational tick alone (no opinion dynamics) for 5 simulated years at 30-day steps on a fresh genesis population. Record every death with its country and age.

metrics.le_tracking: fraction of countries with >= 20 recorded deaths whose mean age at death is within +/- 6 years of the census life expectancy (GENESIS_COUNTRIES 'le', UN-derived)
metrics.world_adult_cdr: annualized deaths per 1000 agents across the whole (18+ only) population

caveats: The population is adults-only (18+) with fixed-N slot replacement, so births == deaths by construction and infant mortality is out of scope; the band [6,15] reflects adult-only crude death rates, wider than the UN all-ages world CDR (~8).

amendments.what: The temporal leg gains exogenous historical forcing: GDELT monthly tone/volume timelines (2017-2022, fetched once from the DOC 2.0 API, cached in data/gdelt_history.json) are replayed through the SAME adapter force-mapping and gain path the live receiver uses, with Welford baselines warmed on a full-period climatology pass. Evolution window shrinks to the replay window (~6y, the API's historical floor is Jan 2017). Three conditions run with identical seeds: endogenous (A1-era reference), real geography, and shuffled geography (country labels permuted — the inline §14 placebo control). PASS: real beats no-change on MAE AND real beats shuffled on MAE AND real sign accuracy > 0.5 at p < 0.05.
amendments.rationale: Runs #3-#5 established the physics arc: 63.7% sign accuracy on the broken v1 pyramid, 39.7% on cohort entry without trait aging, 44.3% (~parity) on correct stationary physics. Endogenous dynamics alone cannot track history — secular drift requires exogenous signal, exactly as the §14 grounding stack intends. The shuffled-geography control ensures a pass cannot come from global-average forcing alone: the signal must carry country-specific information.
amendments.unchanged: Calibration remains Wave-6-only; W7 stays held out. The A1-era endogenous criterion remains recorded per run for reference but no longer gates.

amendments.what: The le_tracking metric changes from period mean-age-at-death vs LE to a cohort simulation: per distinct census LE value, a synthetic cohort is stepped from age 18 through the SAME hazard code path and dt-scaling the generational tick uses, until extinction; the cohort's mean age at death must be within +/- 6 years of census LE for >= 90% of LE values. Rationale: run #2 exposed (a) a genuine physics bug — the Gompertz calibration pinned the MODAL age at death to LE, leaving mid-life hazard several times life-table rates (fixed in earth1/generational.py, commit follows this amendment); and (b) a metric design error — period mean-age-at-death in a young standing population sits far below cohort LE even under correct physics, so the registered metric could not pass regardless. The cohort metric tests the implementation (dt scaling, age encoding, clipping), not the analytic calibration, and is not satisfiable by construction: bugs in the tick path fail it.
amendments.unchanged: The world_adult_cdr band [6,15] stays as registered — it is an external anchor (UN-derived adult mortality). Run #2 plus the hazard fix shows it will fail for a now-diagnosed reason: the genesis age structure under-represents the elderly (all-ages census median used as adult mean, thin-tailed normal). That failure is the leg doing its job; fixing genesis age sampling alters the frozen manifold and is a founder decision, not a harness tweak.
